notes.text: The heading names Rav Acha bar Rav Azza; the target names Rav Ada bar Rav Azza, continuing across the line break. Acha and Ada remain distinct; ברב is rendered bar Rav. The selected scan transcription differs from the separate Wikisource witness, which has only ערב רב אדא ברב עזא.
